about: Hand-checked permits from Washington's local clean air agencies for our terminals' facilities (PSCAA, ORCAA; SWCAA pilot), 2026-10-07. One entry per terminal and agency. Every permit's number and holder are checked against the agency's own document text at import (lib/ships/waAirAgencies.js); 'why' says how the holder and site were matched (company + the site address the agency gives). 'covers' quotes a permit document's own words about the dock, ship loading or vessel fueling, with page. 'none' is shown where nothing was found, with what was searched. Notices of violation and penalties are not published by these agencies; PSCAA's reach EPA ECHO and are shown from there. Sources and method: docs/PERMITS_SOURCES.md (WA local clean air agencies).
